narrative.title: The Barcode Segment Matcher
narrative.scenario: A scanner vendor validates label formats by finding the longest block of glyphs that appears contiguously in two barcode strips. Contiguity is the whole point — a scattered overlap is worthless for calibrating the reader. The calibration utility reports the length of that longest continuous shared block.
narrative.inputFormat: Integers n and m, plus strings S1 and S2 of lengths n and m.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the length of the longest string that occurs contiguously in both S1 and S2.
constraints: strings consist of uppercase English letters

testCases.explanation: The block "CDGH" runs contiguously through both strings.
"cjk" is the longest unbroken shared run.

hintLevels: Level 1: A shared run must be unbroken, so a mismatch resets the streak to zero instead of inheriting neighbors.
Level 2: dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1] + 1 on a match, else 0; the answer is the max over the whole table.
Level 3: Track the running maximum during the fill; a single rolling row suffices.
